purpose: Reads the procurement method of each exported award and deadline pair, then applies the events-in-order record consistency rule. The rule's own cited profile settles what each method means; this watcher records which method was read and that it was read from the pair, so the lens used on every row is visible and sealed.

record.unit: one distinct (ocid, award id, award date, tender end date) pair exported from the watch journal

definition.text: The procurement method, from the closed method codelist.

selection.note: The rule's profile cites each method's definition and decides whether a submission period exists.
The rule refuses on its own cited terms when the method is missing; the watcher records that the fact was missing. Missing is not zero.

otherwise.reason: Procurement method is published but is not a code of the cited closed codelist; expected publisher: contracting authority
